svg.title: Services for cross-border needs
svg.desc: Services for cross-border needs. Observed advertising at Lee Kin Driving School, Sheung Shui. The signs concern driving-licence conversion, not vehicle registration plates; service use and effectiveness were not assessed.
svg.text: LENS B / SHEUNG SHUI FIELD OBSERVATION
Assistance advertised by a local driving school
Sheung Shui observation [8]; Jamie’s photograph of Lee Kin Driving School
The signs advertise driving-licence conversion, not vehicle registration-plate conversion. Provision is observed; uptake is not measured.
